title: Scope.
bodyText: Except where made expressly applicable to domestic reciprocal insurers, the provisions of this part shall apply to all authorized reciprocal insurers.
bodyHtml: §431:4-402  Scope.  Except where made expressly applicable to domestic reciprocal insurers, the provisions of this part shall apply to all authorized reciprocal insurers. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2]
